title: Universal catenarity checked on minimal-prime quotients
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring. Then $A$ is universally catenary if and only if $A/\mathfrak p$ is universally catenary for every minimal prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $A$. [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-exc-excellent-ring]
